title: Multipresence
summary: MULTIPRES'ENCE, noun [Latin multus, many, and proesentia, presence.] The power or act of being present in many places at once, or in more places than one.

inlines.v: MULTIPRES'ENCE, noun [Latin multus, many, and proesentia, presence.] The power or act of being present in many places at once, or in more places than one.
